definitions.explanation: A tendency to suspect and distrust others' motives. Describes a deep-seated, often irrational mistrust.

examples.japanese: {猜疑心|さいぎしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: That person is very suspicious of others.

examples.japanese: {猜疑心|さいぎしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{信|しん}じられなく→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Because of suspiciousness, they couldn't trust anyone anymore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}り→裏切り：17967_uragiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{猜疑心|さいぎしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}え{付|つ}けた→植え付ける：19913_uetsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Years of betrayal planted deep suspiciousness in his heart.

notes:
A literary word describing a deep, persistent tendency to distrust others. Composed of {猜疑|さいぎ} (suspicion, jealousy) + {心|しん} (heart, mind). The character {猜|さい} specifically implies jealous suspicion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猜疑心|さいぎしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to be very suspicious
- {猜疑心|さいぎしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor suspicion
- {猜疑心|さいぎしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}られる→駆る：14715_karu⟧: to be driven by suspicion
- {猜疑心|さいぎしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塊|かたまり}→塊：03905_katamari⟧: a bundle of suspicion (very distrustful person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧: doubt, suspicion — everyday word for doubt or suspicion
- ⟦{不信感|ふしんかん}→不信感：16762_fushinkan⟧: distrust, mistrust — more neutral; can refer to specific distrust
- {警戒心|けいかいしん}: wariness, vigilance — more positive; implies reasonable caution
- ⟦{被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}→被害妄想：18124_higaimousou⟧: persecution complex — stronger; implies delusion

REGISTER:
Appears in literature, psychology, and formal writing. In everyday conversation, ⟦{疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い→疑い深い：18592_utagaibukai⟧ (suspicious, skeptical) is more natural.
